bug_semantics: Attacker-controlled CDATA containing the terminator ]]> can reach XMLSerializer. The serializer emitted node.data verbatim between CDATA delimiters, so the embedded terminator closes the section and the remaining attacker-controlled bytes become active XML markup. createCDATASection accepted the terminator directly, and CharacterData mutation or direct data/textContent assignment supplied additional paths to the same unsafe serializer sink.
flaw_origin: Commit 5fb8fb92b2cb9d7c6b8b5477900e90619b14e432 is the smallest surviving public-history commit that first added XMLSerializer and its CDATA_SECTION_NODE branch `return buf.push('<![CDATA[', node.data, ']]>')` without validation or splitting. Its immediate parent already had createCDATASection but had no XMLSerializer/CDATA serialization sink, so that parent is not vulnerable through the advisory's serialization mechanism.
ai_marker: No AI marker exists on the BIC: commit 5fb8fb92b2cb9d7c6b8b5477900e90619b14e432 has author and committer jindw <jindw@xidea.org>, an empty message, no trailers, and a 2012-01-04 timestamp. Repository-level AI signals and the 2026 remediation are not evidence about the BIC.
evidence: The frozen bundle's GitHub advisory GHSA-wh4c-j3r5-mjhp describes the unsafe CDATA serialization, identifies CVE-2026-34601, and declares @xmldom/xmldom <0.8.12 and >=0.9.0,<0.9.9 affected, with 0.8.12 and 0.9.9 patched; legacy xmldom <=0.6.0 has no patched release.

The official CVE API record https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-34601 was checked on 2026-08-30: cveMetadata.state is PUBLISHED, and its affected ranges and references agree with the GitHub advisory; the record is not rejected or withdrawn.

Local Git diff 5d770d4c04466fd4a99b0762d28b8d1d111ba0c7..5fb8fb92b2cb9d7c6b8b5477900e90619b14e432 shows the BIC first adding XMLSerializer.serializeToString and the unsafe CDATA_SECTION_NODE emission. Inspection of 5d770d4c04466fd4a99b0762d28b8d1d111ba0c7:dom.js shows createCDATASection but no XMLSerializer or CDATA serialization branch.

Commit 5fb8fb92b2cb9d7c6b8b5477900e90619b14e432 is a one-parent commit whose full parent is 5d770d4c04466fd4a99b0762d28b8d1d111ba0c7; it is not a merge and exposes no finer public-history member to decompose.

Direct fix 2b852e836ab86dbbd6cbaf0537f584dd0b5ac184 rejects ]]> in createCDATASection and splits every ]]> during CDATA serialization. Tag 0.9.9 contains this commit; tag 0.9.8 precedes it. The 0.8.x branch applies the same two mitigations in backport ed08df7572f4236d4fd88d16063c3fd8f59c7884, contained in 0.8.12 after vulnerable 0.8.11.
The BIC metadata and complete message contain no AI attribution, generated-by marker, assistant trailer, or co-author trailer; only the BIC is used for the AI-role judgment.
reasoning: The exploitable source-to-sink chain is attacker-controlled CDATA data to the serializer branch introduced by 5fb8fb92b2cb9d7c6b8b5477900e90619b14e432, which emitted the terminator-bearing data verbatim. The immediate parent lacks that serializer sink, while the BIC adds it in one ordinary public commit. The direct fix and its 0.8.x backport close both direct creation and mutation paths, and the release tags match the advisory boundaries. Because the real advisory is PUBLISHED and the BIC itself has no AI marker and was authored in 2012, the correct causal verdict is NOT_AI.
